description: Edit a post that has not gone out yet (status pending, queued or draft): its text, its scheduled time, its first comment, or its tags. Changing the time moves when it publishes, so confirm the new text and time with the user first. Published posts cannot be edited.

first_comment.description: New first comment, or null to remove it.

post_id.description: Post UUID — from list_posts or get_calendar.

scheduled_at.description: New ISO 8601 datetime with timezone offset, e.g. 2030-01-01T09:00:00+05:30.

tag_ids.description: Replace the post's tags with these post tag UUIDs (max 20); [] removes all.

name: update_post
